arguments.code:
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NhLXNtaXRAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.e9MmfEe6ERnhEd2AVrTMD3W4pM-a5MyNgluVYkrwm0g')
current_positions = [item['position'] for item in queue if item.get('is_current')]
print('current_positions:', current_positions)
current_position = current_positions[0] if current_positions else None
played_so_far = [item for item in queue if item['position'] <= current_position]
print('played_so_far_count:', len(played_so_far))
print('played_so_far_song_ids:', [item['song_id'] for item in played_so_far])
print('played_so_far_titles:', [(item['title'], item['song_id'], item['position']) for item in played_so_far])

access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2NhLXNtaXRAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.e9MmfEe6ERnhEd2AVrTMD3W4pM-a5MyNgluVYkrwm0g'
results=[]
for item in played_so_far:
    try:
        r=apis.spotify.like_song(song_id=item['song_id'], access_token=access_token)
        results.append((item['song_id'],'ok',r))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((item['song_id'],'fail',str(e)))
print('like_results:', [(sid,status) for sid,status,_ in results])
print('fail_details:', [(sid,err) for sid,status,err in results if status=='fail'])

liked_song_ids=set()
page_index=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-liked_at')
    print('page_index', page_index, 'resp_type', type(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    # resp is list
    print('page_count', len(resp))
    page_ids=[item['song_id'] for item in resp]
    liked_song_ids.update(page_ids)
    if len(resp)<20:
        break
    page_index+=1
print('total_liked_song_ids_collected', len(liked_song_ids))
